title: ProofOfEmptiness
description: Inception Framework strict-initial-object invariant (I2): every morphism X -> the empty artifact must be a certified isomorphism. A ProofOfEmptiness (PoE) certifies that an erase/redact/delete/quarantine flow drove object X down to the canonical empty value of its schema via a two-phase erase-iso (shred -> certify), with shred_digest == empty_digest under a declared canonicalization. The deletion gate is fail-closed: any flow typed X -> empty that lacks a certified PoE is rejected. Pairs with the deletion gate (reversibility-before-destruction) and the capability lattice in ADR-036.

subject_ref.description: Reference to the object X being erased.

schema_id.description: SCHEMA-ID whose canonical empty value (and empty_digest) this PoE references.

context_id.description: JSON-LD @context pin, to forbid schema games (AEAD must cover schema_id + context_id).

method.description: Two-phase isomorphism: X --shred--> X0 --certify--> empty. No other path to empty is admissible.

canonicalization.description: Canonical byte encoding under which digests are computed (e.g. TritPack243, canonical-json).

empty_digest.description: Schema-bound digest of the canonical empty value H(empty) for schema_id.

pre_digest.description: Digest of X before erasure. If pre_digest == empty_digest then X was already empty (X ≅ empty).

shred_digest.description: Digest of the zero-information variant X0 after shred. For decision=certified-empty this MUST equal empty_digest.

capability_ref.description: Capability under which erasure ran. Must dominate the erase-iso capability requirement; bottom capability cannot certify.
